clips.title: The story
paras: Blackrock Bounty is a defense contract issued by Guard Howe in Lakeshire on behalf of Magistrate Solomon. With Stormwind failing to dispatch reinforcements, the town pays independent adventurers to cull the elite Blackrock Champions massing in the northern mountains. Striking down these battlefield unit commanders is aimed at disrupting the orc clan's coordinated assault on Redridge.

Redridge has long fallen under the sovereign rule of the Kingdom of Stormwind, but the Blackrock clan does not honor human borders. Pouring down through the mountain passes leading from the Burning Steppes, the orcs have established heavily fortified encampments across northern Redridge. With King Varian Wrynn missing and the regency in Stormwind withholding royal soldiers, local leaders like Magistrate Solomon have been forced to put up bounties from the town's dwindling coffers to protect Lakeshire.

Guard Howe identifies the Blackrock Champions as the backbone of the invading vanguard. Serving as squad leaders and battle-hardened veterans within their warbands, these champions coordinate troop movements and drive the lesser grunt forces forward. By putting a price on their heads, Lakeshire's defenders hope to break the clan's tactical leadership and stall a full-scale push south before the township's outer perimeter collapses.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Blackrock Clan must be destroyed. The Enemy has invaded our lands. These mountains fall under the sovereign right of the King of Stormwind. Our sources tell us that the leaders of each unit within the Clan are known as Champions. You'll find them in their encampment to the north, just west of the road to the Burning Steppes.
Magistrate Solomon wants these foul brutes dead. Slay 15 Blackrock Champions and return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Return once you have slain 15 Blackrock Champions.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I see you have fought valiantly against the Blackrock Clan, adventurer. Your service to our township is great indeed.
